title: An Ideal for Living
notes: Self-released punk debut: rushed riffs, confrontational delivery and rough production precede the later spacious sound.

title: Unknown Pleasures
sounds_like: The Cure|Bauhaus|Siouxsie and the Banshees|Iggy Pop (The Idiot)|David Bowie (Low)
notes: Melodic lead bass and isolated drums inhabit Hannett’s stark, spacious post-punk studio sound.

title: Closer
sounds_like: The Cure|Bauhaus|New Order|Public Image Ltd|David Bowie (Low)
notes: Expansive, bleak final album balancing muscular rhythms with synthesizers, electronic percussion and austere songs.
